tools.name: pdf_to_text

tools.name: india_ifsc

tools.name: india_pincode

tools.name: extract

tools.name: papers_search

tools.name: agent_venues_summary

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "india_ifsc" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: web_to_markdown, read_batch · Private data: base_address · Public sink: india_pincode.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: web_to_markdown, read_batch · Private data: base_address · Public sink: india_pincode

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
